Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Brielle Fairbanks | DOB: 08/13/1967 | MRN: SYN-5021230
Date of service: 01/23/2025 | Dr. Lucia Merriweather, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
57-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2021, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: seasonal allergies, type 2 diabetes.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 25 mg weekly for 24 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: active seropositive rheumatoid arthritis; clinical disease activity index fifteen today.
Latent TB blood test and hepatitis B panel drawn on 12/22/2024 both came back clear.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
